# Document fixtures

These small, synthetic documents are original Reader fixtures covered by the
project's MIT license. They contain no personal documents or credentials.

- `quiet-coast.epub`: original prose, metadata, ordered chapters and navigation;
  long chapters exercise pagination, search and restored reading positions.
- `footnotes.epub`: synthetic cross-chapter notes and inline references.
- `test-multipage.pdf`: synthetic pages for reading and PDF editing workflows.
- `test-encrypted.pdf`: a synthetic password-protected document; its test password
  is public fixture data.
- `multiline-prose.pdf`: synthetic multi-line text for source-coordinate selection
  and signature checks.

The Great Vibes font in `assets/fonts/` is used for typed signatures, not the
interface. It retains its separate SIL Open Font License alongside the font.
